items.title: 14.5 Impact of human activities on the atmosphere (insanon ke kaamon ka atmosphere par asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Human activities atmosphere par bohat asar dalti hain, khaas taur par fossil fuels jalane aur deforestation (jangal kaatna) ke zariye. In se climate change, air pollution, kharab air quality aur doosre environmental problems (masle) paida hote hain.

Urban (shehri) ilaqon mein zyada tar air pollution human sources se aati hai. Yeh sources mobile (cars, trucks, hawai jahaz, samandari engines) ya point sources (factories, bijli ghar waghaira) hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Chaar human activities batayein jo air quality kharab karti hain, aur har ek ka ek pollutant likhein.
blocks.explanation: Gariyon mein fuel jalana: CO, NOₓ, VOCs. Bijli gharon aur bhattiyon mein coal jalana: SO₂ aur PM. Jangal kaatna aur fasal ki baqi bachi cheezen (crop residue) jalana: CO₂ aur dhuen ke particles. Factories, metallurgy aur koora jalana: lead aur mercury jaisi heavy metals.

items: Human asar zyada tar fossil fuels jalane aur deforestation se; shehron mein pollution mobile aur point sources se.
